_comment: Copy this file to 'install-config.json' next to Setup.exe (NOT inside this repo) and edit it before running the installer on a venue machine. Every field is optional - omit anything you don't want pre-filled; the operator can always fill it in later via Settings. This file is applied ONCE, only to a brand-new installation - it is never read again on an upgrade. A Windows account PASSWORD must never be added here (there is no such field, on purpose) - see ledsync/services/install_config.py.
